text:
maya: Heads-up: VoiceOver tests show extra tab stops inside the playground run area when tool calls are collapsed. Options: make every label tabbable or add a "Jump to latest" skiplink + aria-live updates. Which do we prefer?

jesse: Skiplink + aria-live. Less noisy for keyboard users. Make the skiplink visible on focus so discoverable. :thumbsup:

samir: Agreed. Important: programmatic focus to the target (tabindex='-1' + focus()). Use role='region' and aria-live='polite' on the run container so screen readers get updates. Also include sr-only summary for collapsed callstacks (e.g., "3 tool calls, newest: TranslateText - success").

ellen: Copy suggestion: use short label "Jump to latest" for the skiplink. Tool button label: "Run tool" (concise and clear). I'll add small tooltip text for sighted users with the keyboard shortcut.

maya: Can someone put a tiny Storybook demo up? Tag a11y and schedule a quick VoiceOver check.

access-bot: Accessibility check scheduled: 2024-04-03 10:00 PT. Invite sent to maya, samir, ellen, jesse.
